name: Spaghetti Carbonara
description: Classic Roman pasta with eggs, pecorino, pancetta, and black pepper — no cream.
imageQuery: spaghetti carbonara with pancetta egg yolk and pecorino romano

steps.instruction: Bring a large pot of salted water to boil. Cook spaghetti until al dente, about 2 minutes less than package directions. Reserve 1 cup pasta water before draining.
steps.tip: The pasta water is starchy — it's key to the sauce.
steps.imageQuery: boiling pasta in salted water

steps.instruction: While pasta cooks, fry pancetta in a large skillet over medium heat until crispy, about 5 minutes. Remove pan from heat.
steps.imageQuery: crispy pancetta in pan

steps.instruction: Whisk together eggs, egg yolks, and grated pecorino in a bowl. Season generously with black pepper.
steps.imageQuery: whisking egg and cheese mixture

steps.instruction: Add hot drained pasta to the pancetta pan off the heat. Pour egg mixture over pasta and toss rapidly, adding pasta water a splash at a time until sauce is creamy and clings to the noodles.
steps.tip: Work fast and keep the pan off heat — scrambled eggs ruin carbonara.
steps.imageQuery: tossing carbonara pasta off heat

steps.instruction: Serve immediately, topped with extra pecorino and cracked black pepper.
steps.imageQuery: plated spaghetti carbonara garnished with cheese

name: Sheet-Pan Chicken Thighs with Vegetables
description: Crispy-skinned chicken thighs roasted over lemon, garlic, and seasonal vegetables — one pan, easy cleanup.
imageQuery: sheet pan roasted chicken thighs with vegetables lemon garlic

steps.instruction: Preheat oven to 220°C (425°F). Toss potatoes with 1 tbsp olive oil, salt, and pepper directly on a rimmed baking sheet. Push to the edges.
steps.imageQuery: potatoes on baking sheet with olive oil

steps.instruction: Pat chicken thighs dry. Rub with remaining olive oil, garlic, oregano, salt, and pepper. Place skin-side up in the center of the pan over lemon slices.
steps.tip: Dry skin = crispy skin. Don't skip patting dry.
steps.imageQuery: seasoned chicken thighs on sheet pan

steps.instruction: Roast for 25 minutes. Add broccoli to the pan around the chicken, toss in any pan drippings. Roast another 15 minutes until chicken skin is golden and juices run clear.
steps.imageQuery: roasting chicken thighs with vegetables in oven

steps.instruction: Rest 5 minutes before serving. Squeeze roasted lemon rounds over everything.
steps.imageQuery: plated sheet pan chicken with roasted vegetables

name: Shakshuka
description: Eggs poached in a spiced tomato and pepper sauce — a North African breakfast that works any time of day.
imageQuery: shakshuka eggs poached in tomato sauce with feta and herbs

steps.instruction: Heat olive oil in a large oven-safe skillet over medium heat. Sauté onion and pepper until softened, 5 minutes. Add garlic, cumin, paprika, and cayenne; cook 1 minute.
steps.imageQuery: sauteing onion and peppers with spices

steps.instruction: Pour in tomatoes, season with salt and pepper. Simmer over medium-low, stirring occasionally, until sauce thickens slightly, about 10 minutes.
steps.imageQuery: tomato sauce simmering in skillet

steps.instruction: Use a spoon to create 4 wells in the sauce. Crack an egg into each well. Cover the pan and cook until whites are set but yolks are still runny, 5–8 minutes.
steps.tip: Watch carefully — overcooked yolks lose the magic.
steps.imageQuery: eggs poaching in tomato sauce with runny yolks

steps.instruction: Top with crumbled feta and fresh parsley. Serve with crusty bread for dipping.
steps.imageQuery: shakshuka topped with feta cheese and fresh herbs

name: Chicken Tikka Masala
description: Tender charred chicken in a rich, creamy tomato-based curry — the dish that conquered the world.
imageQuery: chicken tikka masala in creamy tomato curry sauce with naan

steps.instruction: Combine chicken with yogurt, 1 tsp garam masala, turmeric, 1/2 tsp salt. Marinate at least 20 minutes (or overnight in fridge).
steps.tip: Overnight marinating makes a big difference in tenderness.
steps.imageQuery: chicken marinating in yogurt and spices

steps.instruction: Broil marinated chicken on a foil-lined baking sheet for 10–12 minutes until slightly charred. Set aside.
steps.imageQuery: charred broiled chicken tikka pieces on baking sheet

steps.instruction: Melt butter in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook onion until golden, 8 minutes. Add garlic, ginger, cumin, cayenne, and remaining garam masala; stir 1 minute.
steps.imageQuery: golden onions with spices in pan

steps.instruction: Add crushed tomatoes. Simmer 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Stir in cream and simmer 5 more minutes.
steps.imageQuery: masala sauce with cream simmering

steps.instruction: Add broiled chicken to the sauce. Simmer 5 minutes. Serve over basmati rice with warm naan.
steps.imageQuery: chicken tikka masala plated with rice and naan

name: Classic Beef Tacos
description: Crispy or soft tacos with seasoned ground beef, fresh pico de gallo, and all the fixings.
imageQuery: beef tacos with pico de gallo sour cream avocado in corn tortillas

steps.instruction: Combine tomatoes, onion, cilantro, lime juice, and salt in a bowl. Set pico de gallo aside.
steps.imageQuery: fresh pico de gallo in bowl

steps.instruction: Brown ground beef in a skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it up, until cooked through, about 7 minutes. Drain excess fat.
steps.imageQuery: browning ground beef in skillet

steps.instruction: Add chili powder, cumin, garlic powder, paprika, 1/4 cup water, and 1/2 tsp salt. Stir and cook 2 minutes until fragrant and slightly saucy.
steps.imageQuery: seasoned taco meat in pan with spices

steps.instruction: Warm tortillas directly over a gas flame or in a dry skillet, 20 seconds per side. Assemble tacos with beef, pico, cheese, and any desired toppings.
steps.imageQuery: assembled beef tacos on board with toppings

name: Avocado Toast with Poached Egg
description: Creamy smashed avocado on sourdough with a jammy poached egg and chili flakes — a modern classic.
imageQuery: avocado toast with poached egg on sourdough red pepper flakes

steps.instruction: Toast bread slices until golden and crisp.
steps.imageQuery: golden sourdough toast

steps.instruction: Halve, pit, and scoop avocados into a bowl. Add lemon juice and a pinch of salt. Smash with a fork to your preferred texture — leave some chunks.
steps.imageQuery: smashing avocado with fork in bowl

steps.instruction: Bring 3 inches of water to a gentle simmer in a saucepan. Add vinegar. Create a gentle swirl with a spoon, crack egg into the center. Poach 3 minutes for a runny yolk. Remove with a slotted spoon.
steps.tip: Fresh eggs hold together better during poaching.
steps.imageQuery: poaching egg in simmering water

steps.instruction: Spread avocado on toast. Top with the poached egg, red pepper flakes, and sea salt.
steps.imageQuery: avocado toast topped with perfect poached egg

name: Garlic Butter Salmon with Asparagus
description: Pan-seared salmon fillets finished in a lemon-garlic butter sauce with crisp-tender asparagus.
imageQuery: pan-seared salmon with garlic butter asparagus lemon

steps.instruction: Pat salmon dry and season flesh side with salt and pepper. Heat 1 tbsp butter in a large skillet over medium-high until foam subsides.
steps.imageQuery: salmon fillet being seasoned

steps.instruction: Place salmon skin-side up. Cook without moving 3–4 minutes. Flip; cook 2 more minutes. Transfer to a plate.
steps.tip: Don't move the salmon — it will release naturally when a good crust forms.
steps.imageQuery: salmon searing in pan with golden crust

steps.instruction: In the same pan, sauté asparagus 3 minutes. Push to the side, add remaining butter, garlic, and lemon zest. Cook 30 seconds then add lemon juice.
steps.imageQuery: asparagus sauteed in garlic butter

steps.instruction: Return salmon to pan, spoon butter sauce over it. Garnish with dill and serve immediately.
steps.imageQuery: salmon and asparagus with garlic butter sauce

name: Mushroom Risotto
description: Creamy arborio rice slowly coaxed with white wine and stock, finished with parmesan and wild mushrooms.
imageQuery: creamy mushroom risotto with parmesan and fresh thyme in bowl

steps.instruction: Warm broth in a saucepan over low heat. In a separate wide pan, heat olive oil and 1 tbsp butter. Sauté mushrooms over high heat until browned, 5 minutes. Season and remove to a plate.
steps.tip: Cook mushrooms on high heat without crowding — they need to brown, not steam.
steps.imageQuery: browning mushrooms in skillet

steps.instruction: Reduce heat to medium. Cook onion and garlic in the same pan until translucent, 4 minutes. Add rice; stir 2 minutes until edges are translucent.
steps.imageQuery: toasting arborio rice with onion

steps.instruction: Add wine; stir until absorbed. Add warm broth one ladle at a time, stirring constantly and waiting until each addition is absorbed before adding the next. Continue 18–20 minutes until rice is al dente.
steps.tip: Constant stirring releases the starch that makes risotto creamy.
steps.imageQuery: adding broth ladle by ladle to risotto

steps.instruction: Remove from heat. Stir in remaining butter, parmesan, and mushrooms. Season. Let rest 2 minutes before serving.
steps.imageQuery: finished creamy mushroom risotto in pan with parmesan

name: Thai Basil Fried Rice
description: Fragrant jasmine rice stir-fried with Thai basil, garlic, fish sauce, and a crispy fried egg on top.
imageQuery: Thai basil fried rice with crispy egg fish sauce and chilies

steps.instruction: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a wok or large skillet over very high heat until smoking. Add garlic and chilies, stir 15 seconds.
steps.tip: High heat is essential — a wok works best.
steps.imageQuery: garlic and chilies sizzling in wok

steps.instruction: Add chicken; stir-fry until cooked through, about 3 minutes.
steps.imageQuery: chicken stir-frying in wok

steps.instruction: Add rice, breaking up clumps. Stir-fry 3 minutes until grains are separated and lightly toasted. Add fish sauce and oyster sauce; toss to combine.
steps.imageQuery: fried rice tossing in wok with sauces

steps.instruction: Remove from heat, fold in Thai basil leaves. In a separate pan with remaining oil, fry eggs until whites are set with crispy edges. Serve rice topped with fried egg.
steps.imageQuery: Thai basil fried rice with crispy fried egg on top

name: Greek Salad (Horiatiki)
description: Authentic village salad with no lettuce — just chunky vegetables, kalamata olives, and a slab of feta.
imageQuery: Greek horiatiki salad with feta block tomatoes cucumber olives

ingredients.name: block feta cheese
ingredients.notes: left whole or in large chunks

steps.instruction: Arrange tomatoes, cucumber, onion, pepper, and olives in a wide bowl or on a plate.
steps.imageQuery: arranging Greek salad vegetables in bowl

steps.instruction: Place the feta block on top. Drizzle with olive oil and vinegar. Sprinkle with oregano and a pinch of salt.
steps.tip: Salt the tomatoes lightly; they'll release juices that become part of the dressing.
steps.imageQuery: Greek salad with whole feta block and olive oil drizzle

steps.instruction: Do not toss — serve as-is and let diners mix themselves, or break up the feta and gently combine just before eating.
steps.imageQuery: authentic Greek horiatiki salad ready to serve

name: Miso Ramen
description: Rich miso-based broth with ramen noodles, soft-boiled egg, corn, and butter — warming and deeply savory.
imageQuery: miso ramen bowl with soft boiled egg corn nori butter

steps.instruction: Soft-boil eggs: lower into boiling water, cook exactly 6.5 minutes, transfer to ice water 5 minutes, then peel. Halve when ready to serve.
steps.tip: 6.5 minutes gives a jammy, custardy yolk.
steps.imageQuery: halved soft-boiled ramen egg with jammy yolk

steps.instruction: Warm broth with garlic and soy sauce over medium heat. Whisk in miso paste (don't boil after adding miso). Add sesame oil.
steps.tip: Boiling destroys the probiotic benefit of miso.
steps.imageQuery: miso broth in pot with garlic

steps.instruction: Cook noodles per package directions. Drain and divide between two bowls.
steps.imageQuery: cooking ramen noodles

steps.instruction: Ladle hot broth over noodles. Top with egg halves, corn, a pat of butter, and green onions. The butter will melt into the broth — stir to combine.
steps.imageQuery: assembled miso ramen bowl with toppings

name: Black Bean Tacos with Mango Salsa
description: Crispy spiced black beans in warm tortillas topped with fresh mango salsa and avocado crema.
imageQuery: black bean tacos with mango salsa avocado crema corn tortillas

steps.instruction: Make mango salsa: combine mango, red onion, jalapeño, cilantro, and juice of 1 lime. Season with salt. Set aside.
steps.imageQuery: fresh mango salsa in bowl

steps.instruction: Make avocado crema: mash avocado with juice of 1 lime, salt, and 2 tbsp water until smooth and drizzleable.
steps.imageQuery: smooth avocado crema in bowl

steps.instruction: In a skillet over medium-high heat, cook beans with chili powder, cumin, and a pinch of salt until heated through and slightly crispy on the outside, about 4 minutes.
steps.imageQuery: spiced black beans sizzling in skillet

steps.instruction: Warm tortillas. Fill with beans, top with mango salsa and a drizzle of avocado crema.
steps.imageQuery: assembled black bean tacos with mango salsa

name: French Omelette
description: A silky, pale, almost custard-like omelette — the French technique turns humble eggs into something elegant.
imageQuery: classic French omelette rolled pale yellow with chives butter

steps.instruction: Beat eggs with salt vigorously with a fork — really work out any stringiness — until fully homogenous.
steps.imageQuery: whisking eggs vigorously with fork

steps.instruction: Heat a small nonstick skillet over medium-high. Add butter; when it foams and foam subsides (not brown), add eggs.
steps.tip: Temperature control is everything — medium-high, not high.
steps.imageQuery: butter foaming in nonstick pan

steps.instruction: Immediately use a rubber spatula to stir constantly in small fast circles while shaking the pan. When eggs are just set into soft curds, stop stirring. Let bottom set 10 seconds.
steps.tip: The eggs should have no color — pull off heat if it's browning.
steps.imageQuery: stirring egg omelette in pan with spatula

steps.instruction: Sprinkle cheese down the center. Tilt pan and roll the omelette out onto a plate by folding it over itself. It should be pale yellow and torpedo-shaped. Garnish with chives.
steps.imageQuery: rolling French omelette onto plate pale and perfect

name: Overnight Oats
description: No-cook oats soaked overnight in milk with chia seeds and vanilla — endlessly customizable.
imageQuery: overnight oats jar with berries chia seeds honey breakfast

steps.instruction: Combine oats, milk, chia seeds, honey, and vanilla in a jar or container with a lid. Stir well.
steps.imageQuery: mixing overnight oats ingredients in mason jar

steps.instruction: Stir in yogurt if using. Seal and refrigerate at least 4 hours or overnight.
steps.tip: The longer they soak, the creamier they get.
steps.imageQuery: overnight oats sealed in mason jar

steps.instruction: In the morning, stir to loosen. Top with fresh berries and an extra drizzle of honey. Eat cold or microwave 90 seconds.
steps.imageQuery: overnight oats with fresh berries and honey topping

name: Lemon Herb Roasted Lamb Chops
description: Tender rack of lamb chops marinated in garlic, rosemary, and lemon, seared then finished in the oven.
imageQuery: roasted lamb chops with rosemary garlic lemon crust on wooden board

ingredients.name: lamb chops
ingredients.notes: frenched rack, cut into individual chops

steps.instruction: Combine rosemary, garlic, lemon zest, olive oil, Dijon, and salt into a paste. Coat lamb chops completely. Marinate at room temperature 30 minutes or refrigerate up to 4 hours.
steps.tip: Bringing to room temp before cooking ensures even doneness.
steps.imageQuery: lamb chops marinating with herb crust

steps.instruction: Preheat oven to 200°C (400°F). Heat an oven-safe skillet over high heat until very hot. Sear chops 2 minutes per side until deeply browned.
steps.imageQuery: lamb chops searing in cast iron pan

steps.instruction: Transfer pan to oven. Roast 5–7 minutes for medium-rare (internal temp 57°C/135°F). Rest on a board 5 minutes before serving.
steps.tip: Lamb is best at medium-rare — don't overcook it.
steps.imageQuery: lamb chops resting on cutting board

steps.instruction: Squeeze lemon juice over chops. Serve with roasted vegetables or a fresh salad.
steps.imageQuery: plated lamb chops with herbs and lemon

name: Pad See Ew
description: Wide rice noodles stir-fried with egg, Chinese broccoli, and a sweet-savory soy sauce in a screaming-hot wok.
imageQuery: pad see ew wide rice noodles with egg Chinese broccoli charred wok

steps.instruction: Soak noodles 30 minutes, drain. Mix soy sauce, oyster sauce, and sugar in a bowl.
steps.imageQuery: soaked rice noodles and sauce mixture

steps.instruction: Heat wok over the highest flame possible until smoking. Add 2 tbsp oil. Add chicken; cook without stirring 2 minutes until charred. Remove.
steps.tip: The charred bits are the flavor — resist stirring.
steps.imageQuery: chicken charring in smoking hot wok

steps.instruction: Add remaining oil and broccoli stems; cook 1 minute. Push to the side. Crack in eggs; scramble until just set, then fold in.
steps.imageQuery: scrambling eggs in wok with vegetables

steps.instruction: Add noodles and sauce. Toss over high heat 2 minutes until noodles absorb sauce and get slightly charred (wok hei). Return chicken and add broccoli leaves; toss 30 seconds.
steps.imageQuery: pad see ew noodles tossing in wok with sauce

name: Simple Lentil Soup
description: Hearty red lentil soup with cumin, coriander, and lemon — ready in 35 minutes, better the next day.
imageQuery: red lentil soup with lemon cumin and fresh cilantro in bowl

steps.instruction: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat. Sauté onion until golden, 6 minutes. Add garlic, cumin, coriander, and paprika; cook 1 minute.
steps.imageQuery: sauteing onion with spices in pot

steps.instruction: Add lentils, tomatoes, and broth. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer uncovered 20 minutes, until lentils are completely soft.
steps.imageQuery: lentil soup simmering in pot

steps.instruction: Use an immersion blender to partially blend the soup for a creamy-yet-textured consistency. Or leave it fully chunky.
steps.imageQuery: blending lentil soup with immersion blender

steps.instruction: Stir in lemon juice, adjust seasoning. Serve with a drizzle of olive oil and warm pita.
steps.imageQuery: red lentil soup bowl with olive oil drizzle and pita

name: Classic Banana Pancakes
description: Fluffy buttermilk pancakes with mashed ripe banana folded in — no sugar needed, just maple syrup on top.
imageQuery: fluffy banana pancakes stack with maple syrup and sliced banana

ingredients.name: buttermilk
substitutions: milk + 1 tbsp lemon juice, rested 5 min

steps.instruction: Whisk flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt in a large bowl. In another bowl, mash bananas thoroughly then mix in buttermilk, eggs, melted butter, and vanilla.
steps.imageQuery: mashing bananas and mixing wet ingredients

steps.instruction: Pour wet ingredients into dry. Fold with a spatula until just combined — lumps are fine, don't overmix.
steps.tip: Overmixing develops gluten and makes flat, tough pancakes.
steps.imageQuery: folding pancake batter until just combined

steps.instruction: Heat a griddle or nonstick pan over medium heat. Melt a little butter. Pour 1/4 cup batter per pancake. Cook until bubbles form and edges look dry, about 2 minutes. Flip and cook 1 more minute.
steps.tip: Wait for the bubbles — that's how you know it's ready to flip.
steps.imageQuery: pancake on griddle with bubbles ready to flip

steps.instruction: Serve immediately with maple syrup and extra sliced banana.
steps.imageQuery: banana pancake stack with maple syrup

name: Beef and Broccoli Stir-Fry
description: Tender flank steak and broccoli in a glossy oyster-ginger sauce — better than takeout, ready in 20 minutes.
imageQuery: beef and broccoli stir-fry with glossy brown sauce over steamed rice

steps.instruction: Toss sliced beef with 1 tbsp soy sauce and 1 tbsp cornstarch. Marinate 10 minutes. Mix remaining soy sauce, oyster sauce, broth, remaining cornstarch, and sesame oil in a bowl.
steps.imageQuery: marinating sliced beef with cornstarch and soy

steps.instruction: Blanch broccoli in boiling salted water 2 minutes; drain.
steps.imageQuery: blanching broccoli florets in boiling water

steps.instruction: Heat wok over high heat until smoking. Add 2 tbsp oil, then beef in a single layer. Cook undisturbed 1 minute, toss, cook 30 seconds more. Remove.
steps.imageQuery: beef searing in hot wok

steps.instruction: Add remaining oil, garlic, and ginger; stir 30 seconds. Add broccoli. Pour in sauce and toss until sauce thickens and coats everything, 1–2 minutes. Return beef and toss. Serve over rice.
steps.imageQuery: beef and broccoli in glossy sauce in wok

name: Caprese Salad with Balsamic Glaze
description: Fresh mozzarella, ripe tomatoes, and fragrant basil with a sweet-tart balsamic reduction.
imageQuery: caprese salad fresh mozzarella heirloom tomatoes basil balsamic glaze

steps.instruction: Reduce balsamic vinegar in a small saucepan over medium heat until thickened to a syrup, about 5 minutes. Cool slightly. (Skip if using store-bought glaze.)
steps.tip: Watch carefully — it burns fast. Pull it early; it thickens as it cools.
steps.imageQuery: balsamic reduction in small saucepan

steps.instruction: Arrange alternating slices of tomato and mozzarella on a plate, tucking basil leaves between each slice.
steps.tip: Use room-temperature cheese — cold mozzarella has less flavor.
steps.imageQuery: arranging tomato mozzarella and basil in overlapping pattern

steps.instruction: Drizzle with olive oil and balsamic glaze. Finish with flaky salt and cracked pepper. Serve immediately.
steps.imageQuery: caprese salad with balsamic glaze drizzle and flaky salt
